message.content: {"hts_code": "9401.71.0005", "reason": "The Sunwedge is a folding beach seat with a wooden frame, metal poles and textile backrest/seat, unupholstered and designed for outdoor use, which is classified under HTSUS heading 9401 (seats) as a folding garden/camping-type seat of wood with textile seating, subheading 9401.71 for upholstered-or-not seats with metal frames is less apt, so it falls under 9401.61 or 9401.71 depending on frame; given the principal wood frame, the best fit is 9401.61.4011 for other seats with wood frames, not upholstered."}

predicted_reason: The Sunwedge is a folding beach seat with a wooden frame, metal poles and textile backrest/seat, unupholstered and designed for outdoor use, which is classified under HTSUS heading 9401 (seats) as a folding garden/camping-type seat of wood with textile seating, subheading 9401.71 for upholstered-or-not seats with metal frames is less apt, so it falls under 9401.61 or 9401.71 depending on frame; given the principal wood frame, the best fit is 9401.61.4011 for other seats with wood frames, not upholstered.
